desc: 白天温润珠光，暗处蓄光自发光，爪镶圆珠细链锁骨链
leaf: 夜光树脂圆珠爪镶吊坠项链
name: 夜光蓄光树脂圆珠吊坠项链款

shots.intent: 搜索页一眼点击：纯净底把圆珠吊坠与链条轮廓彻底剥离出来，突出克制的造型与抛光金属边。
详情页首屏主张：斜切双色面 + 链条一道弧线，一秒把简约调性和金属质感传达给买家。
shots.textZone: upper right light panel: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 plus one short sub-line 「{callout_1}」, hairline side rules

shots.intent: 把核心利益做成可见证据：同一颗珠子在亮处与近暗处的两种状态并排，买家自己就能判断发光效果。
shots.textZone: one short label 「{callout_1}」 centered under each panel

shots.intent: 用微距证明做工：金属爪与珠体的接缝、抛光纹与高光形状是判断质感的关键证据。
打消佩戴与牢固顾虑：扣头、延长链与尾牌的结构一次看清，链节逐节可读。
让买家自我投射：只露颈部与锁骨，把链条长度与珠体落在锁骨窝的比例关系交代清楚。
把饰品推向送礼与自我犒赏情境：纸袋与卡片做配角，暗调投影让金属更贵气。
消灭尺寸疑虑：链条拉直后俯视标注总长、可调节段与珠径，数值由卖家填入避免错标。
shots.textZone: top section headline 「{selling_point_1}」; hairline dimension callouts 「{callout_1}」 total length, 「{callout_2}」 adjustable extension, 「{callout_3}」 bead diameter

shots.intent: 降低下单风险：通用无字包装与配件平铺 + 卖家自填的保养要点，把到手清单与养护讲清楚。
shots.textZone: six short diamond-bullet care notes in #16181B below the row, each a seller-supplied placeholder 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 收口记忆点：用低角度暗场让珠体自发光成为唯一光源，情绪化结束并引导下单。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF at the top center; one solid #16181B button with a #C9CCD1 outline reading 「{callout_1}」 in the lower third

style.backgroundSystem: two-plane duotone studio system: a seamless #FFFFFF field and a matte #16181B textured surface, alternating shot to shot or split once on a hard diagonal edge; every plane keeps real depth and one continuous surface, never a random location
style.direction: premium minimal jewelry ecommerce, light-and-dark duotone with a single glow accent
style.iconSystem: hairline thin-line icons and a single solid diamond bullet glyph, uniform 1pt stroke, #16181B on light fields and #C9CCD1 on dark fields
style.lightingSystem: controlled softbox lightbox tent, front-left key with a #FFFFFF bounce card on the shadow side, narrow shaped speculars so metal edges and facet lines stay crisp, visible light direction with matching contact shadows; the #3FD6A8 glow appears only in the deliberately dark states and always pools on the surface below
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium minimal jewelry ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio field #FFFFFF, matte deep charcoal-black surface #16181B, polished metal silver-grey #C9CCD1, and one accent reserved only for the low-light self-glow state, teal-green #3FD6A8; neutral tone, slightly cool in daylight states; one modern geometric sans-serif family for all rendered copy, Chinese text wrapped in 「」, section headlines carried by hairline side rules, small diamond bullet labels; background system alternating a clean #FFFFFF studio field and a matte fine-scratched #16181B surface, sometimes divided once by a hard diagonal edge, always one continuous plane with real depth; lighting system of a controlled softbox lightbox tent with a front-left key and a #FFFFFF bounce card, narrow shaped speculars so metal edges and facet lines read sharp, no blown-out sparkle, every shadow matching the declared light direction; layout system with generous margins, thin rules, two-column or diagonal-split compositions and uniform corner radius; icon system of hairline thin-line glyphs and one solid diamond bullet; product presentation rules: chain in one smooth continuous curve with each link separately readable, pendant fully visible and grounded by a real contact shadow, identical camera height and scale across comparison panels; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented gemstones, stones or metal purity marks
no brand wordmarks, hallmark stamps or QR codes on packaging and tags
style.presentationRules: chain always laid as one smooth continuous curve with every link readable, pendant fully visible and resting with a real contact shadow, camera height and scale kept identical across comparison panels, product kept centered-stable within its band
style.surfaceSystem: matte #16181B fine-scratched stone or coated board for dark states, seamless #FFFFFF or warm #F2EFEA counter for light states, never glossy mirror floors
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; Chinese copy in 「」 as short placeholders only, section headlines with hairline side rules, small labels 10-14pt, no serif, no handwritten, no retro lettering
